plugins.name: mcp-events-bridge
plugins.description: Watch MCP Events bridge events (GitHub, Resend, webhooks) in the background: Claude is told as each one happens.

plugins.name: mcp-events-bridge-lite
plugins.description: Wait for MCP Events bridge events (GitHub, Resend, webhooks) while Claude works on a request, with nothing running in the background. Install this or mcp-events-bridge, not both.
